newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ghana 96/97 cocoa price at 75,000 cedis/60 kg bag.
newsitem.headline: Ghana 96/97 cocoa price at 75,000 cedis/60 kg bag.

text.p: Ghana's state marketing Cocoa Board (Cocobod) said the country's 1996/97 main crop season would open on Friday at a purchase price of 75,000 per 60-kg bag, the official Ghana News Agency reported.
It said the price per 30 kg load would be 36,000 cedis for grade one and grade two naked ex-scale.
A Cocobod statement sent to the Ghana News Agency on Tuesday said the new producer prices would be paid at all buying centres in Ghana.
A tonne of 16 bags would be set at 1.2 million cedis, it added
